messages:
sara: quick heads-up — ran the nightly link-scan against the onboarding/runtime guide and found a cluster of dead shortlinks under /runtime/onboarding/* (mostly 403/404 from the old cdn). grabbing a couple of small examples: rg 'cdn\.examplecorp\.com/.+' docs/runtime/onboarding | head -n 5. can someone claim ownership? i can open tiny PRs rehosting images and swapping shortlinks, but want to avoid stepping on whoever owns that guide. :eyes:

ben: i can take the rehost PRs if no one objects. how many files are we talking? and do we prefer rehost -> assets.redwood-inference.com or inline base64 for the two tiny diagrams?

sara: thanks ben. ~8 files flagged, 4 images are small svgs, rest are screenshots. prefer assets.redwood-inference.com for durability. i'll add the scan output to the PR description. plan: small commits per file, one CI run each.

hao: fwiw, if you want a quick local find/replace for the shortlink pattern:

    # find files referencing the old shortlink host
    rg "cdn\.examplecorp\.com" docs/runtime/onboarding -n

    # sed to replace to new host (dry-run first)
    sed -n "s#https://cdn.examplecorp.com/#https://assets.redwood-inference.com/#gp" <path-to-file>

also add label `docs:shortlink-migration` and tag me for review on svg optimizations.

docs-bot: automated scan result: 8 hits in 7 files under docs/runtime/onboarding; severity: medium; suggested action: rehost images or update shortlinks. https://internal-scanner/reports/1839999001

mike: quick nit — if any of those pages are included in the onboarding quickstart, reach out to the onboarding squad before merging. we had a small redirect in place last year and they might prefer a different canonical path.

sara: good call — i'll ping @onboarding in the PR and add a short note in the description.

ben: i'll start the branch now: `docs/shortlink-rehost/1839999001` and open the PR as draft. assigning `docs:owner-unassigned` for now, set to `docs:needs-owner` if nobody claims. ETA EOD today for first 3 files. :thumbsup:

sara: awesome — leaving the ownership ping here for visibility. small ask: if you see any references to shortlink redirects (example: `/r/abcd`) don't blindly replace them — check whether it's a maintained shortlink and coordinate. last time we replaced a maintained redirect it broke a support workflow.

hao: noted. i'll review the svg files for color profile and strip metadata if needed.

mike: tagging onboarding squad in case they have any quick constraints: @onboarding — FYI small rehost of images in runtime onboarding, no content changes.

ben: draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4201 (WIP). added description + scan link + label. pinging owners on files I touched.

sara: perfect, thanks everyone. leaving this thread open until PRs merge. :sparkles:
